steps.name: Read the reviewed public fixture and workflow
Record managed runner and official CLI interface
steps.run:
gh --version > "$RUNNER_TEMP/canary-gh-version.txt"
gh attestation verify --help > "$RUNNER_TEMP/canary-gh-help.txt"
for flag in cert-identity cert-oidc-issuer source-ref source-digest signer-digest signer-workflow deny-self-hosted-runners predicate-type bundle format; do grep -Fq -- "--$flag" "$RUNNER_TEMP/canary-gh-help.txt"; done
sha256sum -- "$(command -v gh)" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/canary-gh-sha256.txt"
sha256sum -- docs/fixtures/attestation-canary.txt .github/workflows/attestation-canary.yml > "$RUNNER_TEMP/canary-input-sha256.txt"
printf 'repository=%s
ref=%s
sha=%s
run_id=%s
run_attempt=%s
runner_os=%s
runner_arch=%s
image_os=%s
image_version=%s
' "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" "$GITHUB_REF" "$GITHUB_SHA" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" "$RUNNER_OS" "$RUNNER_ARCH" "$ImageOS" "$ImageVersion" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/canary-run.txt"

steps.name: Attest only the fixed public text
Retain the genuine bundle for this exact run

with.name: attestation-canary-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
with.path:
${{ steps.attest.outputs.bundle-path }}
docs/fixtures/attestation-canary.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/canary-gh-version.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/canary-gh-help.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/canary-gh-sha256.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/canary-input-sha256.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/canary-run.txt
